answer: A work-weighted identity cost resists Sybils best. Each agent must post unrecoverable stake and show accepted outputs before its votes count. Spawning a thousand fresh addresses is cheap, but each one starts at zero weight and must burn compute and settle escrow first, so one actor holds at most one honest share however many identities it mints. The vertex of the design is that weight never transfers, making farmed accounts a relic, and honest agents reach their economic zenith on earned stake. Each fake identity multiplies the attacker's sunk cost while yielding no extra influence.
